Jensen Huang declared at NVIDIA GTC Taipei 2026 that we are in the greatest era in history to build software, driven by AI agents. Contrary to fears that AI will replace software, he emphasized it will ignite unprecedented demand for new software and tools.

• AI agents represent the future of computing, where users explain their intent and AI generates code or uses tools to deliver results—termed "Agentic AI."
• A major breakthrough enabling this shift is the ability of AI agents to use tools, transforming how software interacts with systems.
• Instead of replacing software companies, Agentic AI will dramatically increase demand for software, as millions of agents require tools to function.
• Software must now be designed for agents, not just humans, making tool accessibility and integration a critical innovation frontier.
